Jwt.//SigningKey: Development only. Never reuse this value outside a local machine.

SignIn.//LogUndeliveredSecrets: Development only. There is no SMS or email adapter yet, so one-time codes and password-reset links are written to the log. Both are credentials — never enable this where logs leave the machine.

Invitations.//LogUndeliveredLinks: Development only. There is no email adapter yet, so the accept link is written to the log. The link is a credential — never enable this where logs leave the machine.
